stages.native:
WITH clock AS (SELECT public.olap_reporting_date() today), chosen AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT borrower_id,has_active_loan FROM public.reporting_borrower_directory_v1 WHERE borrower_id= [[{{borrower_id}} --]] '__select_borrower__'
), selected_health AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT borrower_id,current_health_status,rating_status,reliability_score,confidence,reason_text,overdue_principal,overdue_interest,oldest_unpaid_days,calculated_at FROM public.reporting_borrower_payment_health_v1 WHERE borrower_id=(SELECT borrower_id FROM chosen)), selected_matrix AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT borrower_id,quadrant,classification_reason,arrangement_status FROM public.reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 WHERE borrower_id=(SELECT borrower_id FROM chosen)) SELECT h.current_health_status AS "Current health",h.rating_status AS "Rating status",h.reliability_score AS "Payment score /100",h.confidence AS "Confidence",coalesce(m.quadrant,'Outside active cohort') AS "Category",coalesce(m.arrangement_status,CASE WHEN c.has_active_loan THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE 'No active loan' END) AS "Schedule",h.reason_text AS "Payment reason",m.classification_reason AS "Category reason",h.overdue_principal AS "Overdue principal ฿",h.overdue_interest AS "Overdue interest ฿",h.oldest_unpaid_days AS "Oldest overdue days",to_char(h.calculated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Queried at" FROM chosen c LEFT JOIN selected_health h USING(borrower_id) LEFT JOIN selected_matrix m USING(borrower_id)

questions.description: R035 additive borrower pages. Immutable borrower keys; Bangkok dates; current health from V41/V42. Signed receipts. No AppSheet/financial writes.

stages.native:
WITH clock AS (SELECT public.olap_reporting_date() today), chosen AS (SELECT * FROM public.reporting_borrower_directory_v1 WHERE borrower_id= [[{{borrower_id}} --]] '__select_borrower__'
), input AS (SELECT [[{{amount}} --]] 0
 AS amount), total AS (SELECT CASE WHEN bool_and(outstanding_principal IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(outstanding_principal) END principal FROM public.reporting_borrower_directory_v1 WHERE loan_count>0)
 SELECT CASE WHEN i.amount<0 OR i.amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') THEN 'Enter a nonnegative finite amount' ELSE 'Scenario only · no loan saved' END AS "Status",c.outstanding_principal AS "Current principal ฿",CASE WHEN i.amount>=0 AND i.amount::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') THEN c.outstanding_principal+i.amount END AS "Proposed principal ฿",CASE WHEN t.principal>0 THEN c.outstanding_principal/t.principal END AS "Current share",CASE WHEN i.amount>=0 AND i.amount::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') AND t.principal+i.amount>0 THEN (c.outstanding_principal+i.amount)/(t.principal+i.amount) END AS "Proposed share" FROM chosen c CROSS JOIN input i CROSS JOIN total t

visualization_settings.text:
## Borrower Portfolio
Capital, interest contribution and lending activity. Current positions stay current when activity dates change.

### Borrower comparison
Click a name to open the new Detail tab with these activity dates. Shares use the selected population; hidden operational records remain included.

Gross interest is before expenses. Principal returned may relate to older loans. First/repeat uses lifetime loan order. [Borrower Health Review](/dashboard/3?tab=31) owns categories and the matrix. Live query time does not prove payments have synced.

## Borrower Detail
Select one borrower above. Empty selection shows no financial totals. Activity dates affect the period sections only.

### Activity · selected Bangkok dates
Health uses its own governed rolling window. Due today is not overdue; a payment today can cure debt without erasing historical lateness.

### Additional lending scenario
Hypothetical additional principal only; no loan is saved and no health score changes. Next-plan amounts above are recorded plans, not additional debt.

All amounts are baht. Lifetime/current sections ignore activity dates. Allocations are not unique receipts; corrections remain signed. [Borrower Health Review](/dashboard/3?tab=31) explains categories, confidence and automatic schedule restrictions.
